title.narrative: Gender for Democracy: Strengthening Gender Justice in Georgia and Ukraine

description.narrative: The objective of the project is to improve gender justice in Georgia and Ukraine within the areas of women's leadership and political participation, prevention and response to sexually gender based violence, gender stereotypes, capacity of civil society, and equality in the labour market. The project contributes towards ending all forms of gender based discrimination, eliminating all forms of violence against women, reducing all forms of violence and improving rule of law through strengthening capacities of feminist, gender justice and LGBTIQ+ groups to document, raise awareness, build capacity, network, mobilise, campaign and advocate with rights holders and duty bearers to improve legal frameworks and practices. By bringing rural women’s voices to the fore in politics, supporting female candidates in elections and strengthening capacities for women in leadership, the project contributes to opportunities for leadership and decision-making and inclusive, representative decision-making.
